auxiliary_core.description: Scaled sanity case for auxiliary construction: DDAR alone fails, while a CPU-only auxiliary construction enables proof.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of benchmark problems solved by the submitted method within the slice's counted attempt budget.

solved_count.description: Number of benchmark problems solved within the slice's counted attempt budget; included to make tiny-slice changes visible.

problem_count.description: Number of scored problems, reported for denominator auditing rather than optimization.

mean_attempt_index.description: Average successful or terminal attempt index; lower values indicate less search needed.

mean_auxiliary_count.description: Average number of auxiliary clauses emitted per problem, penalizing bloated constructions.

attempt_budget.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-attempt budget, a machine-independent search cost constraint.

rounds.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-construction rounds, penalizing larger search procedures.

timeout_seconds.description: Declared per-problem timeout budget, used as a resource cap rather than a wall-clock speed score.

neural_inference_used.description: Whether neural proposal inference was used; the paper's core constraint is CPU-only non-neural search.

hageo409_low_difficulty.description: HAGeo-409 low-difficulty-band comparison against the paper's [1,3) Random@2048 baseline and HAGeo@2048 rates (Table 1); reproduced runs use a fixed smaller slice from the same band and a documented smaller budget.

solve_rate.description: Fraction of low-difficulty HAGeo-409 problems solved by the submitted method.

solved_count.description: Number of low-difficulty HAGeo-409 problems solved, preserving count-level visibility on small slices.

problem_count.description: Number of scored problems, reported for denominator auditing rather than optimization.

upper_band_solve_rate.description: Solve rate on rows with difficulty at least 1.4, catching methods that only target the easiest visible cases.

difficulty_weighted_solve_rate.description: Difficulty-weighted solved fraction, rewarding gains that transfer across the harder part of the slice.

attempt_budget.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-attempt budget, a machine-independent search cost constraint.

rounds.description: Declared maximum auxiliary-construction rounds, penalizing larger search procedures.

timeout_seconds.description: Declared per-problem timeout budget, used as a resource cap rather than a wall-clock speed score.

neural_inference_used.description: Whether neural proposal inference was used; lower preserves the paper's non-neural search constraint.
